news.headline: Nebraska's jab at Ohio State's 'THE' leads top Week 12 CFB trolls
news.description: Nebraska deployed a simple but effective troll that poked fun at its opponent's propensity to emphasize the "the" in "The Ohio State University."

news.headline: Preseason No. 1 Oho State suffers fourth loss, will 'evaluate what's going on'
news.description: For coach Ryan Day and his Ohio State Buckeyes, the dream of a College Football Playoff run is dead, as the preseason No. 1 team in college football lost its fourth game on Saturday afternoon, a 31-28 decision at the hands of the Nebraska Cornhuskers.

news.headline: BYU retains CFP hopes, beats Kansas in triple overtime
news.description: Bear Bachmeier connected with Jojo Phillips in the back of the end zone in the third overtime, helping No. 10 BYU beat Kansas to keep its CFP hopes alive.

news.headline: Nebraska snaps AP Top 25 losing skid, upsets Ohio State
news.description: Nebraska broke its 31-game losing streak against AP Top 25 opponents with a 31-28 victory over No. 16 Ohio State on Saturday.

news.headline: Syracuse QB Steve Angeli exits with injury, arm in sling
news.description: Syracuse senior quarterback Steve Angeli left Saturday's game against Boston College with an injury to his throwing arm and will not return.

wiki.title: Trevor Lauck
wiki.intro: Trevor Lauck (born September 27, 2004) is an American college football offensive tackle for the Iowa Hawkeyes.
